summary: A weak June jobs report and Trump's new 50% copper tariff are the week's twin drivers. Soft payrolls ease near-term rate-hike odds and support equities and crypto, but the copper levy adds a cost-push inflation signal that keeps real rates elevated and bonds under pressure.
tweet: Soft jobs + a 50% copper tariff: stocks and crypto stay bid on rate relief, but bonds and gold stay pinned as inflation risk refuses to fade.
